sentence: A group of medicines that stop testosterone turning into the hormone DHT; finasteride, described by the NHS for an enlarged prostate and male pattern hair loss, is one of them.
The MHRA has issued safety warnings about psychiatric side effects and sexual dysfunction for finasteride and dutasteride.
note: Title of MHRA drug safety update: Finasteride and dutasteride, updated safety warnings for psychiatric side effects and sexual dysfunction.

sentence: These medicines work by stopping testosterone, a sex hormone, turning into another hormone called dihydrotestosterone (DHT).
note: NHS About finasteride describes finasteride as a 5-alpha reductase inhibitor with this action.

sentence: Sexual side effects such as losing interest in sex and difficulty getting an erection are the main side effects the NHS lists for finasteride.
The MHRA says finasteride is associated with depression, suicidal thoughts and sexual dysfunction, and has added a precautionary warning for dutasteride.
Finasteride can affect PSA blood test results, so a doctor is told about it before the test.
MedlinePlus says touching broken or crushed finasteride tablets may harm an unborn baby.
For thoughts of self-harm the NHS says to call 999 or go to A&E.
